description: courtscheduler.move-hearing-to-past-date — books a hearing onto past session(s), both jurisdictions, single OR multi-day. Multi-day books CONSECUTIVE weekday sessions (one room + business type) for both jurisdictions. courtRoomId scopes the search to the requested room (contract aligned with main); startTime/endTime are UTC instants whose DATES drive the [startDate, endDate] span (multi-day when endTime's date is after startTime's date) and whose TIME-of-day is otherwise informational. The past-only rule is owned by the caller (listing); courtscheduler does not reject future dates.
